bio.text: Josh Harder represents California's 9th Congressional District, which covers San Joaquin County and parts of Stanislaus and Contra Costa counties.
According to his House website, his family has lived in San Joaquin County for five generations, and he lives in Tracy.

He was born in Turlock, California, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Stanford University (2008) and master's degrees in business administration and public policy from Harvard University (2014).
His career included work as a consultant with The Boston Consulting Group, vice president at Bessemer Venture Partners, and course instructor at Modesto Junior College.
He is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
